description: Section title with count, description and optional action.

howToUse: Use it to open each section of a page: "Members", "Recent invoices", "API keys".
The `title` becomes an `<h2>`. Show how many items there are in `count` and put a link or small button in `action` ("Manage").
Give it an `id` when the page has a TableOfContents. Use `rule` on dashboards.
alternatives: The top of the page: PageHeader.

keyboard.action: Moves to the action, when there is one.

props.name: sub
props.description: Subtitle/description under the title (max 62ch, secondary color).

props.name: count
props.description: Section counter, rendered as a neutral `Badge` (e.g. "3 projects").

props.name: action
props.description: Inline action on the right (link "Manage →", `Button` sm, etc.).

props.name: id
props.description:
Section anchor `id`, matches `TableOfContents` (scrollspy).
The component already applies `scroll-margin-top` for the fixed header.

props.name: rule
props.description: Compact variant with a rule to the edge (dashboard pattern): 12px uppercase title + line filling the space.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
